r2.env_note: Locally they point at the emulator with throwaway keys (.devos/r2.env). In production: Vercel Production env (the two keys marked sensitive) and the same five as GitHub secrets for the deploy's storage preflight. R2_ENDPOINT is https://<account-id>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com; R2_PUBLIC_BASE_URL is the bucket's public URL (r2.dev for a pilot, a custom domain for a real product).
